content.text: Reuben Tracy suspects partner Horace Boyce of dishonesty after overhearing Horace and Schuyler Tenney plotting around the Minster fortune. In Horace’s room, Tenney proposes exploiting the Minsters’ manufacturing investments; Horace hesitates, then joins. At the Minster house, Horace courts Kate, while Reuben later visits her drawing room and discovers the family’s disastrous bonds and trust arrangements. Kate and Ethel secretly consult Reuben in his office; he uncovers fraud, dissolves the partnership, and launches legal action. Jessica Lawton, learning Horace plans to marry Kate, retrieves her son from Tecumseh and later steals incriminating papers while traveling with Reuben from his mother’s farmhouse. Reuben reaches the Minster house during a mob threat and disperses it with a speech. Jessica collapses at General Boyce’s house; dying, she reconciles Horace and Reuben. Separately, the text recounts Louis XVII’s imprisonment and death, Madame Royale’s release and exile, and a later story in which John Smith manages Flora’s fraudulent appeals while concealing his identity and love for Maggie.
